text:
incident-bot: Paging: KV cache hit-rate collapse detected for tenant 'stellarpay' on vpc-us-west-2-dedicated-pool-03. Severity: P1. Symptoms: token cost spike, 95th p90 gen latency increase, degraded prefix hit-rate. Auto-run: collected heap profile and recent prefetch logs. @sre-nate is on-call.

sre-nate: Got it, I'm taking. Looking at per-tenant metrics now.

oncall-lina: I'm on standby to hand off after the next 30m, can mirror.

sre-nate: quick snapshot: prefix-hit-rate for /user/ and /session/ dropped from ~82% -> 3% across that pool, KV eviction churn spiked. Seems correlated with a sudden prefetch volume from tenant 'stellarpay' starting ~1872506000.

eng-miguel: is this the same prefetcher rollout they did last week? I remember a change to aggressive warm-up.

sre-nate: Yep, matching traces show a 40x increase in prefetch requests with small, high-entropy prefixes. Likely saturating shared cache and causing prefix eviction for others.

infra-ashok: immediate mitigation options: 1) throttle prefetch for the tenant, 2) isolate tenant to a reserved pool, 3) bump KV max-entries per-tenant and evict noisy prefixes. Recommend throttling + quick isolation.

eng-miguel: I can push a throttle toggle. Admin API:
```bash
# throttle prefetch to 5r/s for tenant stellarpay
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/tenant/stellarpay/config \
  -d '{"prefetch": {"rate_per_sec": 5}}'
```

sre-nate: Run that now please, and then we should monitor hit-rate over the next 2 mins.

eng-miguel: running...

incident-bot: Action logged: config.update by eng-miguel at 1872510102.

eng-miguel: done. throttle applied.

sre-nate: seeing immediate reduction in prefetch qps from 12k -> ~600. KV eviction rate falling. Prefix hit-rate climbing slowly.

prod-support-julia: drafting customer note: "We've detected abnormal prefetch traffic from your integration which caused shared cache instability. We've temporarily throttled prefetching and moved you to an isolated pool to prevent further impact. We'll share a root cause and follow-up config suggestions." Want to post now?

pm-carla: Hold on on isolation until we confirm baseline. Isolation (move to reserved pool) will cause a config change and brief deploy; prefer to do it as second step if throttling doesn't normalize within 10-15m.

infra-ashok: agreed. if throttling doesn't hit target, we can trigger tenant move with this command:
```bash
# move tenant to reserved pool (dry-run flag available)
ctl tenant relocate --tenant stellarpay --to-pool reserved-usw-7 --force
```

sre-nate: current numbers 4m after throttle: prefix hit-rate for /user/ at 41%, /session/ 38% (was 3%). 95th gen latency down 38%. Still above baseline but improving. I think throttling is working.

prod-support-julia: sending customer note now.

prod-support-julia: "Message sent: short update and mitigation steps. Monitoring closely." :email:

pm-carla: good. Next steps for root cause: get prefetcher traces from their app, add per-tenant prefetch quotas in runtime, and schedule a postmortem for prefetched key patterns.

eng-miguel: I'll add a quick hotfix to runtime to blacklist extremely high-cardinality prefixes from prefetch for 24h. Pushing patch to staging now.

incident-bot: Monitoring rule: tenant.stellarpay.prefetch.qps > 1000 for > 60s will auto-alert and trigger quota enforcement.

sre-nate: After 45m the pool looks stable. No other tenants showing degradation. I recommend we keep throttle in place and not relocate. If we see another spike -> relocate and add per-tenant eviction cap.

pm-carla: please capture timeline and signal for oncall handoff. Lina, I'll hand off docs in 15.

oncall-lina: Roger, I have the timeline. If it re-escalates, wake me or page SRE escalation policy.

sre-nate: Marking incident as mitigated at 1872513600. Will create postmortem ticket, include suggested product change: per-tenant prefetch quotas, per-tenant cache admission control, and an admin tool to evict noisy prefixes.

eng-miguel: added quick eviction tool in staging: `kvctl evict-prefix --tenant stellarpay --pattern "^/tmp/.*"` — we'll standardize next week.

prod-support-julia: closing loop with customer, they want a postmortem and configuration guidance for warm-up best practices.

pm-carla: assign action items: eng to ship prefetch quotas (P1), infra to add tenant isolation runbook (P2), support to coordinate postmortem with customer (P1).

incident-bot: Incident MITIGATED. Tags: kv-cache, tenant-prefetch, throttled, follow-up-required."
